jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description: Requires 6+ years of experience. 6+ years in customer-facing technical roles (Solution Architect/Sales Engineer/Implementation Architect/Technical Account Manager) with a track record influencing complex enterprise deals Background in cybersecurity and/or identity (IAM/PAM, secrets management, and/or cloud security is a plus) Ability to lead solution architecture: design architectures, build POCs, and produce technical collateral (reference designs, playbooks, and reusable assets)
